row.team_price_text: Not listed (usage-based; Try for Free / Request a Demo)
row.evidence: Conductor offers SAML SSO with optional auto-provisioning ("any user who signs in to Conductor using your SSO will have a Conductor user profile created for them automatically") and a User Management API; no SCIM is documented.
row.notes: None by absence (medium): no SCIM on the pricing page, in the docs index (llms.txt indexes, ~285 pages each) or in the user-management OpenAPI spec. SSO (SP-initiated SAML) is on Growth and Enterprise, not Essentials; JIT auto-provisioning is optional. Prices are not published (usage-based, 'not the seats you buy'). Conductor publishes a REST User Management API (create, update access, activate/deactivate, change user type) authenticated by a non-SSO Admin identity; plan gating not stated. Okta's OIN entry is SWA only.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.price_text: Not listed (Try for Free / Request a Demo)
plans.notes: Settings & Integrations table: Single Sign-On (SSO) is '—' for Essentials and '✓' for Growth and Enterprise; Enterprise Permissions (RBAC) is Enterprise only. Pricing is usage-based, not per seat.

scim.notes: No SCIM is documented. SSO is SP-initiated SAML set up by Conductor's engineering team; optional auto-provisioning creates users on first SSO sign-in.

auth.notes: POST /user-api/v1/login with a non-SSO Admin 'application identity' username and password returns a JWT access token valid 24 hours by default.

endpoints.purpose: Log in and get a bearer token
Add or remove accounts a user can access
Update a user's access to an account
Add an account to a user
Remove an account from a user

limitations.text: The API identity must be a separate Admin user that is not SSO-enabled; it manages Standard and Read-only users in the same accounts.
No delete-user endpoint; users are deactivated.

okta.notes: The 2015 OIN entry marks only SWA (password vaulting). Conductor's docs say IdP-initiated sign-in is not supported.

fallbacks.notes: Auto-provisioning on SSO sign-in is optional and chosen with the Conductor representative; JIT users get Read-only permissions and access to all of the organization's accounts.
